title: Independent penetration test letter of attestation
description: Letter from the independent testing firm stating firm, test window, scope (components, environments, roles, release hash), methodology, counts of findings by severity, and remediation and retest status.
producer: External penetration testing firm (not yet engaged)
notes: No independent penetration test of Unbound or any Echelon product has occurred as of 2026-11-25; the Secure Construction Standard states it remains planned.

title: Full penetration test report
description: Complete report with findings, evidence, risk ratings and tester identities, available to customers, auditors and regulators under NDA.
producer: External penetration testing firm (not yet engaged)

title: Penetration test scope and rules of engagement record
description: Signed statement of work and rules of engagement listing in-scope assets, roles, tenant-isolation and business-logic objectives, structural-claim bypass objectives, AI agent interfaces, materials provided to testers, exclusions and their rationale.

title: Tester and firm qualification record
description: Firm accreditations (for example CREST), individual tester certifications, independence declaration and confidentiality terms.
producer: External penetration testing firm (not yet engaged)

title: Penetration finding remediation and retest record
description: Each pen test finding linked to the vulnerability register, fix commit, regression test added, and retest result issued by the testing firm.

title: Customer-initiated testing authorization record
description: Requests from customers to test, approvals, test tenant allocation, rules of engagement, window, and findings returned.

title: First-party adversarial test results
description: Results of internal adversarial, property-based and negative tests against financial invariants and structural controls, with test author distinct from code author, labeled as first-party.
producer: Tutela (security evidence and release posture model exists; not operated for a production Echelon service)
